vitaj.title: Welcome to AI Energy
vitaj.description:
AI Energy plans when to charge the battery cheaply from the grid and when to sell at a higher price – using spot prices and your tariff. It can also charge your EV in the low tariff or from solar surplus.

**Required:**
• a spot price integration installed via HACS – e.g. **OKTE** or **Nord Pool**,
• a battery state of charge sensor in % (usually from your inverter integration, e.g. Solarman).

**Optional:** PV forecast (Solcast), house consumption and grid power measurement, an EV charger controllable from HA (e.g. SmartEVSE).

For the battery AI Energy only **recommends** for now – it does not switch the inverter. EV charging is controlled only after you enable it.

What do you have?

data_description.has_pv: The next steps will ask for a production forecast (Solcast).
data_description.has_ev: The charger must be in Home Assistant (switch or mode select).

ceny.title: Spot prices
ceny.description:
Select the sensor with 15-minute spot prices. OKTE is pre-filled if installed.

If nothing is listed, install the OKTE (or Nord Pool) integration via HACS first and run the wizard again.

data_description.price_today: Sensor from OKTE or Nord Pool, e.g. sensor.okte_prices_today.
data_description.price_tomorrow: Optional. Tomorrow's prices are published around 13:00–14:00 – without them the plan ends at midnight.

nakup.title: Buying electricity
nakup.description:
What you pay for electricity from the grid. Enter the **full price as on your invoice** – including distribution, fees and VAT.

Pre-filled with **ZSE DD3** (EV tariff).

data_description.nt_intervals: When cheaper electricity applies, e.g. 23:45-05:45, 13:45-15:45. Leave empty for a single tariff.
data_description.price_vt: € per kWh, e.g. 0.210. Used for a single tariff.

predaj.title: Selling electricity
predaj.description: How do you sell the electricity you send to the grid (PV surplus or from the battery)?

data_description.sell_mode: With spot price, the battery sells in the most expensive 15-min slots. With I don't sell, nothing is sold and export is limited.

predaj_spot.title: Selling at spot price
predaj_spot.description: The buyer pays the spot price minus their fee.

data_description.sell_fee: How much the buyer deducts from the spot price – € per kWh, e.g. 0.015. See your feed-in contract.

predaj_pevna.title: Selling at a fixed price
predaj_pevna.description: The buyer pays a fixed price. If some hours have a different price, enter that band too.

data_description.soc_entity: Sensor in % – with Deye via Solarman it is “Battery SOC”.
data_description.charge_kw: How many kW the inverter charges from the grid. Deye: max current × battery voltage (200 A × 51 V ≈ 10 kW).
data_description.export_kw: How many kW the inverter exports from the battery (inverter or grid connection limit).
data_description.house_kwh_day: Estimate in kWh per day – yearly consumption / 365. Used until sensor history is available.
data_description.house_sensor: Optional but more accurate: house consumption as energy (kWh) or power (W), e.g. inverter “Load power” – not the grid meter. Average of the last 7 days is used.

fve.title: Solar (PV)
fve.description: With a production forecast the plan knows how much the sun will charge the battery – and does not buy from the grid needlessly.

data_description.pv_power_entity: Optional. Current panel power (W or kW), e.g. inverter “PV power”.

data_description.ev_switch_entity: Entity that turns charging on and off: a switch, or a mode select (e.g. select.smartevse_mode).
data_description.ev_current_entity: Entity that sets the current in A (e.g. Charge Current Override). Without it charging is only switched on/off.
data_description.ev_charging_entity: Optional. Charging sensor (e.g. sensor.smartevse_state) – used to detect a full battery in the Start time mode.
data_description.ev_power_entity: Optional. More precise than the estimate from current.

data_description.ev_min_a: Most cars need at least 6 A.
data_description.ev_max_a: Typically 16 A (3 phases = 11 kW) or 32 A (22 kW).

auto_moznosti.title: Charger modes
auto_moznosti.description:
Your charger is controlled by a mode select. Choose which mode means **charge** and which **off**.

SmartEVSE: **Normal** and **Off**. Do not use Smart or Solar – the charger controls current itself there and would fight AI Energy.

istic.title: Main breaker and grid meter
istic.description: AI Energy keeps the house with a charging EV below the main breaker.

data_description.breaker_a: Amps per phase – for a 3×25 A breaker enter 25. The limit is calculated with a reserve (Advanced).
data_description.grid_power_entity: Recommended. Power at the main meter (+ import, − export). Without it the EV cannot charge from surplus or precisely respect the breaker.

data_description.grid_invert: Enable if the sensor shows grid import as negative (it should be positive when the house draws from the grid).
data_description.breaker_reserve: How many % below the breaker to stay. 10 % at 3×25 A = 15.5 kW limit.
data_description.cable_kw: Only if battery and wallbox share one cable or breaker (e.g. 12 kW). Battery has priority. Empty = not monitored.

hotovo.title: Done

menic.title: Inverter control
menic.description:
AI Energy can send the battery mode to a **select** you already control with your own automation – e.g. `input_select.deye_operation_mode`. That automation then sets the inverter.

Leave empty if you don't want to control the inverter yet – AI Energy will only recommend. Even when set, control stays **off** until you turn on *Battery control*.

data_description.inverter_mode_entity: input_select or select with modes (e.g. Normal, Export from Battery, Charge from Grid…). You map the modes in the next step.
data_description.inverter_current_entity: Optional. Battery grid charging current in A (Deye “Battery grid charging current”). Set from charging power, shared cable with the EV and the main breaker.
data_description.battery_voltage: To convert kW to A, e.g. 51 V (200 A ≈ 10 kW).

menic_mapovanie.title: Mode mapping
menic_mapovanie.description: For each AI Energy mode pick the option of your select that does it on the inverter.

data_description.inverter_option_siet: Battery neither charges nor discharges, house runs from the grid (in low tariff with a full battery). If you have no such mode, pick Zero Export or Normal.
data_description.inverter_option_predaj_fve: Export PV surplus, battery not discharged.

error.no_prices: No prices found in the sensor attributes.
error.invalid_intervals: Invalid times – use HH:MM-HH:MM separated by commas.
error.band_price_required: Enter the price for the band.
error.ev_min_max: Minimum current is higher than maximum.
error.same_option: Charging and off modes must differ.
